notes: Owner decision 2026-09-20: run the Muse delegation lane at the harness ceiling on every dial, to exercise muse-spark-1.3 hard and measure where it breaks. max_workers 5, max_steps 200, max_timeout_seconds 7200 and max_sweep_targets 20 are each the HARD_MAX in delegation_policy.py; max_effort 'max' is the top of EFFORT_ORDER (effort has no hard cap). These are CEILINGS a call may request, not defaults a call receives: each delegation still passes its own --effort and --max-steps, and recipe defaults (12-40 steps) are unchanged. Measured this session: a wide lens starves on SCOPE, not steps -- a 55-step re-run used ~14 -- so raising the ceiling buys headroom for deliberately deep single-seam runs, it does not fix a badly scoped one. Deliberately NOT relaxed: worker_network stays 'restricted', web stays off for investigate/worker, commit and trust_workspace keep their defaults, and model stays unpinned (CLI pin muse-spark-1.3-contributor applies; tier.json flags.sensitive_data is false). Push, pull-request, merge and deploy are not declarable here and remain undelegated.
